title: A/R Collection: the sort stays while changing date, scrolling and filters
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role), with location A as your current location.
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Make sure the report has more than 30 customers with open documents on today's date and on yesterday's date, at both locations.
  • Have a customer, customer A, with open documents at both locations.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Open Balance" header once.
  2. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
  3. Scroll down until the next 30 customers load.
  4. Open the Customer filter.
  5. Tick customer A.
  6. In the Location filter, untick location B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The rows sort by Open Balance, largest first.
  • The header shows it.

Step 2:

  • The report reloads for yesterday and is still sorted by Open Balance, largest first.

Step 3:

  • The new rows are still sorted by Open Balance, largest first.

Step 4:

  • The Customer menu opens.

Step 5:

  • Only customer A's rows remain (expand a group to see them: a filter change collapses every group), still sorted by Open Balance, largest first.

Step 6:

  • Only location A rows remain (expand a group to see them: a filter change collapses every group), still sorted by Open Balance, largest first.
  • "Open Balance" is still marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R7: “The sort is kept while the user stays on the report: changing the as-of date, loading more rows by scrolling, and changing the customer, vendor, Past due or Location filter keep it.”
  • S2-R2: “The first click gives the useful order for the kind of data: text (names, Location, Transaction Type) A to Z; money columns largest first; dates oldest first; Past Due largest first; ID and No. smallest number first (S2-R4). The second click reverses it. The third click repeats the first; there is no unsorted state.”
  • S1-R8: “A/R Summary, A/P Summary, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices show 30 customers or vendors at a time, and the next 30 load as the user scrolls down, as today. There are no page buttons. A/R Detail and A/P Detail show each bucket's first 100 lines, then load more as the user scrolls (S4-R4). Paging never repeats or skips a customer, vendor or row, in any sort.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026
